body:
the biggest award in the room went to a song she'd already put out once. 🧣

at the 2022 vmas, 'all too well: the short film' — built around taylor's re-recorded ten-minute version of a track first released back in 2012 — won video of the year, beating a whole field of brand-new videos. a re-recording, taking the night's top prize. that's how completely the taylor's version project rewrote what a re-recording could be.

we built a whole thread following that campaign album by album — which vaults she's reclaimed, what's still out there, and the paper trail on how it all started. every entry dated and sourced, no rumor-milling.

walk through it: longlivets.com/?lens=taylors-version&utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=thread-taylors-version

(pictured: the taylor's version thread, as it lives on longlivets.com)
